listedDifferences.cause: headroom and rounding, not the mapping (measured, reviewRerun.outside diagnostics): both solvers choose the same parameters (temperature −21.52 vs −21.55, vibrance 71.19 both); solver 1's own corrections rendered through the grade engine give p99 4; applying the look in 8 bits first, as CGA does, gives p99 2. CGA clips and rounds the look's output before its corrections; the grade run keeps the look's out-of-range values

listedDifferences.case: owner clip 9, look+auto (outside only with the per-pixel p99 of F6)
listedDifferences.difference: block RMS 0.9987 (within), per-pixel p99 4 (bound 3), max 6; per-channel p99 was 3
listedDifferences.cause: the clipping budget, not the mapping: solver 1's own corrections rendered through the grade engine give p99 2. Both solvers scale every correction ×0.75 three times; solver 2's prediction then still adds 0.32% clipped pixels (budget 0.3%) and takes a fourth step, so its vibrance is 21.64 against solver 1's 30.85. Applying the look in 8 bits first gives p99 3: the look's headroom changes what counts as clipped. A4's highlight protection replaces this scale-back

listedDifferences.difference: synthetic casts p99 8 and 28; three owner look+auto rows block RMS 1.02–1.16
listedDifferences.cause: Bradford adaptation moves saturated colors differently from channel gains; reported only, not gated, and moved to A4. The (adaptation) rows were measured at 2413125c with the prototype that review F3 removed from this PR

rejected.reason: fails the equivalence gate on saturated colors (synthetic p99 8 and 28); prototyped as an opt-in adaptation model at 2413125c, removed from this PR (review F3), for A4

rejected.experiment: grade.hue-curves hueVsSat skin dip (decision 3's first recommendation)
rejected.reason: one chroma factor per hue also desaturates strong skin-hued colors that vibrance leaves alone: up to 26 codes on a saturated orange, p99 12 over the color cube

rejected.experiment: grade.curves through color.curves' own points (unguarded spline)
rejected.reason: rounds the kinks by up to 3 codes and, through the predicted clipping, made solver 2 scale every correction back ×0.75 on one owner clip (block RMS 1.58, p99 5)

rejected.experiment: gain curves with uniform spacing and no knee guard
rejected.reason: PCHIP flattened the segment before the clip knee: up to 3 codes

a3.title: Look 2
a3.base: codex/cga2-a2 bcb9734c (A2, PR #82, stacked on PR #80; neither merged)
a3.environment: darwin-arm64; Node 22.23.1, pnpm 10.29.3, Playwright 1.62.1/Chromium 1234, FFmpeg 8.0.1 (pnpm toolchain:check passed)
a3.visualAcceptance: none; software measurements only. No look-2 render of the owner clips was looked at by a person; the owner's CGA visual review is still planned on the A6 sheets.

selectionRule.rule: score = mean leave-one-shot-out per-pixel RMS (of 255; in-sample with one shot) + 0.002 per free parameter; lowest score among the requested models in either space
selectionRule.lut: fitted only with --model lut (owner decision 5 open; recommendation followed)

spaces.linear-gamma-2.2: a pure 2.2 power as an unclamped grade.cdl before the model and its inverse after (renders and exports exactly); least squares in linear values

ownerPair.note: 12 raw Flow clips and the owner's graded edit, local only, never committed; 11 shots matched (0 unmatched), 44 pairs, 22,809,600 pixels; per-pixel residuals through the renderer's float ops; heldOut = mean over shots of the leave-one-shot-out per-pixel RMS (block RMS in brackets), of 255

lut.reading: the table beats model 3 held out (1.56 against 1.84) only on the 6% of nodes the pair's colors reach; the other 94% are model 3. Opt-in stays the recommendation; the choice is owner decision 5

ownerPair.runtime: comp look fit --engine grade: 3 min 44 s (decode and match about 25 s; six candidates with 11 held-out refits each)

export.cdl: refused (comp-look-export): the selected look is matrix-curves, not one grade.cdl

checks.check: On the owner's pair, the selected model's held-out per-pixel RMS ≤ 2 of 255 (CGA: 2.30)
A look-1 file applied through look 2 matches color.matrix within the CG2 parity bound

checks.evidence: unit: matrix-curves and look-1 looks 33³ ≤ 2 and 65³ ≤ 1, a LUT look's own table ≤ 1, a 60% bake equals the keyed apply within 2; owner look 33³ 2, 65³ 1. A linear-light CDL look can exceed it near black; the export reports its own round trip and notes it
